skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general principles and regulations of public sector accounting.
Apply budgetary accounting principles to real-world scenarios.
Analyze treasury operations within public sector entities.
Evaluate banking operations within public sector entities.
Apply social insurance accounting principles to real-world scenarios.
Critically analyze policies and methods of accounting in public sector entities.
Think systematically about recognizing, classifying, measuring, recording, preparing, and analyzing accounting reports in public sector entities.
Manage resources effectively and improve operational efficiency.
